messages:
claire: dropped a short design review for the first-run checklist. Main question: should the sample-projects row show both toggles inline or hide telemetry under a "more" chevron?

josh: inline keeps it transparent but clutters. If we hide telemetry it feels like we're burying the opt-in. Lean inline but compact (small labels).

marie: compact inline works if we use clear affordances: label text under 30 chars, toggles right-aligned. Example: "Sample projects
   [Try sample projects] [Share anonymized usage]". Comments?

ux-bot: a11y: two inline toggles must be reachable by keyboard in order. Use `aria-labelledby` for the row and provide `aria-describedby` linking to the privacy note. Visible focus for toggles required.

claire: copy draft for row subtext: "Sample projects may send anonymized example requests for demo purposes. Toggle telemetry to opt in." Too wordy?

josh: shorten: "Demos may send anonymized example requests. Toggle to opt in." Also add a "Learn more" link that opens privacy page in new tab.

marie: design nit: should the telemetry toggle be primary-styled when ON? Might confuse users about which control is the main action. Keep toggles visually equal; use explanatory badge on the sample project card instead.

claire: good call. Also debating default states: legal prefers telemetry OFF by default (explicit consent). For sample projects, product wants ON to reduce friction. Which wins?

legal-bot: legal: telemetry must be opt-in for EU accounts. Global default can be OFF. If you default sample projects ON, ensure we show a clear one-time confirmation on first run stating whether telemetry is enabled for example requests. No pre-ticked options.

josh: pragmatic compromise: both OFF by default; show a friendly inline CTA next to sample projects: "Try now (uses demo data)" with small "enable telemetry" checkbox in that modal. That reduces friction while keeping onboarding clean.

marie: modal on first-run adds friction. Could we have an info popover next to the sample button that surfaces the single checkbox? Lightweight and inline.

infra-bot: implementation: popover can be lazy-loaded; API plans: endpoints `/api/onboard/get-sample-metadata` and `/api/onboard/provision-sample`. Events: `onboard.sample_shown`, `onboard.sample_confirmed`, `telemetry.opt_in_via_onboard`. Keep PII out.

ux-bot: UI keyboard flow: popover should be `role="dialog"`, trap focus while open, Esc to close, and focus returns to the sample button afterward. Ensure screen-reader text announces the checkbox and copy.

claire: microcopy options for the popover (two variants):
Variant 1: "Run demo project
This demo provisions example resources and may send anonymized example requests.
[ ] Enable anonymized usage (off by default)
[Run demo]

Variant 2: "Run demo project
This demo uses sample data to populate logs and dashboards. You can enable anonymized usage to help us improve the product.
[ ] Enable anonymized usage
[Run demo]

josh: prefer Variant 1, shorter. Replace "anonymized usage" with "anonymous usage metrics"? Feels clearer.

marie: agree on wording tweak. Also add a small link "What we collect" that opens the privacy modal.

legal-bot: approve Variant 1 + wording change to "anonymous usage metrics". Ensure we record consent server-side: store (user_id, consent_method, timestamp).

claire: a11y + contrast: our current brand teal on small toggle fails contrast at 3.2:1. Action item: pick darker tint or add 2px border. ux-bot: please update spec.

ux-bot: noted: use darker teal (#006f5f) or add 2px white border + dark focus ring. Provide updated tokens in the spec file.

josh: tracking: funnel events needed: `onboard.row_seen`, `onboard.popover_opened`, `onboard.run_confirmed`, `telemetry.opt_in`. We'll measure sample adoption and telem opt-in rate.

infra-bot: also add a feature flag `onboard.sample_popover_v1` to stage rollout. We'll gate by region and beta users.

marie: final UX decision (proposed): inline compact row showing two labels, popover on first-run for explicit confirmation, both toggles default OFF, copy uses "anonymous usage metrics" and includes "What we collect" link, contrast updated. Send to legal for final lint.

claire: thanks all. I'll update the PR with the popover prototype and the microcopy variants. tagging design-review for quick check tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
